'''Energy blade shields''', also known as a '''battle-shield''', were a type of [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shield]] used for defensive purposes. [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate used energy blade shields among his personal equipment.
